runner.title: Runners
runner.intro: A runner is your own machine: run orbd run --runner --dir <directory> there and threads work right in that directory, using that machine's own omp config and git credentials.
runner.name: Name
runner.tokenOnce: The token for runner {{name}} is shown only once
runner.commandHint: Run it on that machine as a regular user (not root). --dir can be repeated; add --terminal to enable the terminal panel.
runner.emptyHint: Create one, then run the start command on your machine.
runner.gitRepo: Git repository; worktrees can be created
runner.deleteConfirmBody: Its token stops working right away; its threads keep their transcripts and become read-only.

archive.title: Archive thread
archive.body: Archiving moves the thread out of the sidebar. The transcript is kept and you can unarchive any time.
archive.removeWorktreeHint: Runs git worktree remove on the runner. Git refuses if there are uncommitted changes; branch {{branch}} is kept if it isn't merged.
archive.removeFailed: The thread is archived, but the worktree wasn't removed:

identity.title: Accounts
identity.agentHint: The agent account needs write access to the repositories
identity.copyHint: Open it in a browser signed in to the target GitHub account. Valid for 10 minutes.
identity.missingHint: The authorization is missing these scopes and some actions will fail. Reconnect to grant them:

automation.title: Automation
automation.legend: GitHub identity for automated tasks (GitHub triggers, project schedules)
automation.agentMissing: Connect the agent account to choose it

error.state_invalid: The link expired or was already used. Start again.
error.same_account: Can't be the same account as the other slot
error.github_not_configured: The OAuth App configuration was removed. Set it up again, then connect.
error.unknown: The GitHub connection didn't complete. Try again.

project.unbound: No GitHub OAuth App is configured yet.

bindStatus.not_found: My account can't read {{repo}}: it doesn't exist, or this account has no access to it.
bindStatus.org_restricted: The organization that owns {{repo}} restricts OAuth App access. An organization admin needs to approve Oryn's OAuth App.
bindStatus.sso_required: The organization that owns {{repo}} enforces SAML SSO. Authorize Oryn's grant for SSO on GitHub, then reconnect my account.

project.unboundPending: Not linked yet. It links automatically once my account can read this repository.
project.unboundNoUser: Connect My account and this repository links automatically.

triggers.title: Triggers
triggers.empty: No triggers yet. When a trigger matches, Oryn starts a thread and attaches the issue as a data block after the prompt.
triggers.deleteConfirmBody: Threads it already started are kept.
triggers.name: Name
triggers.label: Label
triggers.announce: Reply on the issue with the thread link
triggers.agentMissing: The agent account isn't connected. Connect it under Settings › GitHub to trigger on @ mentions.
triggers.promptHint: Variables: {{vars}}. The issue's title, body, author, labels and the triggering comment are attached after the prompt as a data block.
triggers.presetGates: This preset comes with push and pull request gates. Applying them replaces this project's current gates.
triggers.presetGatesApply: Apply the gates to this project

drivers.label: Drivers
drivers.writersHint: OWNER, MEMBER or COLLABORATOR of the repository, or anyone with write or admin permission on it.
drivers.writers_and_authorHint: Everyone above, plus the author of the issue or pull request.
drivers.anyoneHint: Anyone can drive it, rate limited per person: CONTRIBUTOR 10 times an hour, everyone else 3. Needs the agent account.

triggers.maintainersHint: GitHub logins, comma separated. They can use /model and /thinking and can authorize implementation.
triggers.reviewerBotsHint: Comments from these bots count as maintainer instructions without an @ mention.
triggers.modelsDefault: None picked: the project or global default model is used.
triggers.modelsHint: Each run picks one at random.
triggers.implAuthHint: Opening a pull request on this repository is allowed only for bug or documentation issues, or after a maintainer adds the accepted label or comments go ahead.
triggers.commentOnlyReviewsHint: APPROVE and REQUEST_CHANGES reviews are refused.
triggers.completionRemindersHint: If the task hasn't moved on when a turn ends, remind the agent to continue (at most twice).
triggers.handToAssistantHint: The task's result goes to the global assistant, which decides in the main conversation whether to tell you; no separate notification on completion.
triggers.autocloseHoursHint: After the agent schedules an auto-close, the issue closes if its author hasn't reacted 👎 by then.
triggers.maxDurationHint: When it runs out, the current turn is aborted and you're notified. Leave empty for no limit.
triggers.releasePrefixHint: Only workflow runs whose head commit message starts with this are handled.

gates.title: Push and pull request gates
gates.intro: Enforced by the egress proxy: before pushing or opening a pull request, the agent must pass the commands below with github_prepare.
gates.fixCmdHint: For example a formatter. Its changes are folded into the HEAD commit.
gates.checkCmdHint: Runs before a push, 600 second limit.
gates.testCmdHint: Also runs before a pull request, 3600 second limit.
gates.requireClosingRef: Pull request body must contain Fixes, Closes or Resolves #N

oauth.title: OAuth App
oauth.intro: Oryn connects to GitHub through an OAuth App you register yourself. Create one on GitHub with the callback URL below, then paste its Client ID and Client Secret here.
oauth.register: Register an OAuth App on GitHub
oauth.callbackHint: Use it as the OAuth App's Authorization callback URL.
oauth.secretKeep: Leave empty to keep the saved secret.
oauth.webhookBaseHint: Prefix for the webhooks Oryn creates on repositories; defaults to public_url. When GitHub can't reach it, Oryn polls the delivery log instead.
oauth.deleteConfirmBody: Oryn first removes the webhooks it created on repositories, then disconnects My account and the Agent account. The OAuth App itself stays on GitHub.

hooks.title: Repository webhooks
hooks.intro: Oryn creates one webhook on each linked repository where my account is an admin. Repositories without a working webhook are polled.

explain.active: The webhook works and events arrive live; missed ones are filled in from the delivery log.
explain.no_admin: My account isn't an admin of this repository, so no webhook. While the repository has an enabled trigger rule, Oryn polls its issues and pull requests about every 60 seconds instead. Issues and pull requests linked to threads are polled separately, with or without rules.
explain.org_restricted: The organization restricts OAuth App access. An admin must approve the app before a webhook can be created.
explain.sso_required: The organization enforces SAML SSO. Authorize this grant for SSO.
explain.error: Creating or repairing the webhook failed. Oryn retries periodically.

audit.title: Audit
audit.intro: GitHub writes the agent made through the egress proxy, kept for 30 days.

assistantSettings.modelHint: Default model and thinking effort for new assistant conversations and the main conversation; leave empty to follow system defaults. Changes switch the main conversation too; other existing conversations are unchanged.
assistantSettings.thinkingUnsupported: This model does not support adjusting thinking effort.
assistantSettings.webAccess: Let the assistant use the web
assistantSettings.webHint: The assistant reaches the public internet through Oryn's proxy for web_search and reading web pages; private addresses are refused by default. Both fail when this is off. Changes apply once the assistant's conversations are idle.
assistantSettings.mcpHint: From the global mcp.json (Agent › Extensions & tools). Oryn injects the auth headers; they never enter the assistant's sandbox. Only HTTP and SSE servers are supported.
assistantSettings.mcpEmpty: The global mcp.json has no MCP servers.

reason.stdio: Local process server; it cannot run in the assistant's sandbox
reason.oauth: Needs OAuth sign-in, not supported yet
reason.command_header: Headers come from a command, not supported yet
reason.unresolved_env: A header uses an environment variable that does not exist

assistantSettings.computerHint: The provider and type used to create the assistant's computer; leave empty for the defaults. Only the next creation is affected: reset the existing computer on the “Assistant's computer” page to switch.

assistantComputer.title: Assistant's computer
assistantComputer.noneTitle: The assistant has no computer yet
assistantComputer.noneHint: An orb that belongs to the global assistant, shared by the main conversation and every conversation. The assistant runs commands, works with files and uses a browser in it; it freezes when idle and wakes when needed. It is created the first time the assistant needs it, or you can start it now.
assistantComputer.toolsPending: The computer's tools are not ready yet: after the first wake, the assistant can use them from its next turn.
assistantComputer.resetBody: This deletes the orb and every file in it. The next time the assistant needs it, a fresh computer is created.
assistantComputer.filesAsleep: The computer is not running; wake it to browse files

selectionActions.title: Selection actions
selectionActions.hint: Shown in the context menu when text is selected; your prompt is sent to the model together with the selection.
selectionActions.name: Name
selectionActions.promptHint: Write it as an instruction about the selection, e.g. "Find the flaws in this passage".
